== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：モス・アイズリー</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja"></span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">自分のスパイ、バウンティ・ハンター、密輸屋はすべて戦力と没収値に＋1。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Tatooine: Mos Eisley (Dark)]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. The printed Light Side game-text box is blank. Dark Side. All of your spies, bounty hunters, and smugglers are power and forfeit +1.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Dark names spies, bounty hunters, and 密輸屋; English also names thieves. Uses 戦力. Light game-text box is blank. One Light Force icon and two Dark Force icons. White border.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-tatooinemoseisley.gif|Original English face]], [[Tatooine: Mos Eisley (Dark)]].</ref>
